title: Expiry of a Written Estimate (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
**Rule.** A Repair Estimates & Appointments written estimate that is neither converted nor declined expires.

**Condition.** The estimate type's validity days have fully elapsed since the estimate written date, read from the booking record. Days are calendar days counted from the estimate written date as day zero, and expiry is recorded on the first day after the last valid day.

**Consequences.** An expired estimate cannot be revised or converted; the customer books again. Charges already posted stay due.

| Estimate type (validity) | Last valid day | Expiry recorded on |
|---|---|---|
| Scheduled Estimate (30 days) | day 30 | day 31 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate (45 days) | day 45 | day 46 |

Hypothetical case: a Blueprint Teardown Estimate written on day 0 is still unconverted and undeclined on day 45; it has not expired that day. On day 46 its expiry is recorded, and its teardown charge posted earlier stays due.
